home.heroTitle: Public registry of judicial and administrative auctions
home.heroLead: Synchronised with Spain's BOE Auctions Portal and other official sources. Follow the auctions you care about; we'll alert you when the status changes, a new bid lands, or closing time approaches.
home.heroSubhead: We track them every day and alert you when yours appears.
home.heroSourcesSeo: We track Spain's public auctions daily across every official source: judicial auctions, Tax Agency (AEAT), notarial and administrative auctions published in the BOE; Social Security (TGSS) auctions; and insolvency auctions from the Justice portal (PLABI).

home.nearMeUnavailable: Location unavailable — still showing all of Spain.
home.nearMeShowingIp: Showing auctions near you (based on your connection): {province}.
home.howItWorksP1: We sync with Spain's BOE Auctions Portal and other official sources (Tax Agency, Social Security, notarial, municipal) to maintain our own registry of every public auction: when it's published, when it opens, what bids it receives, when its status changes and when it ends.
home.howItWorksP2: You follow the auctions you care about. We notify you by email or push notification whenever something changes. Bidding always happens on the official BOE portal — we never intermediate.
